scripts.start: node -e "if(process.env.CI==='true'){console.log('CI detected: redirecting to start:serve to avoid exit code 137.');process.exit(0)}else{require('child_process').spawn('npm',['run','_start:dev'],{stdio:'inherit',shell:true})}" && npm run start:serve || npm run _start:dev
scripts.start:ci: cross-env BROWSER=none CI=true HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=${REACT_APP_PORT:-${PORT:-3000}} NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=384 GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=${REACT_APP_ENABLE_SOURCE_MAPS:-false} react-scripts start
scripts.start:lowmem: cross-env BROWSER=none CI=true HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=${REACT_APP_PORT:-${PORT:-3000}} NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=256 GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=${REACT_APP_ENABLE_SOURCE_MAPS:-false} react-scripts start
scripts.start:serve: cross-env REACT_APP_ENABLE_SOURCE_MAPS=false REACT_APP_PORT=${REACT_APP_PORT:-${PORT:-3000}} npm run build:ci && cross-env HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=${REACT_APP_PORT:-${PORT:-3000}} serve -s build -L -n -C --single -l ${REACT_APP_PORT:-${PORT:-3000}}
scripts.prestart: echo "INFO: In CI, 'npm run start:serve' is preferred to avoid exit code 137 (watch server). Using start script will auto-redirect when CI=true."
